detail.longDescription: The old-timers had an unwritten rule: you share the code, you share ideas, you share the connection. But you keep your beer. Because trust is built. It can't be stolen. See what he has to say. But keep your distance. Let him prove himself. If he's really a peer, he'll understand. If he tries to take your beer, you'll know. You're not them. You're you. And you keep your beer!. # bible # unitarian # usenet # cryptography # cryptology # ciphers # Ozark # Yinzer # research
